initial.instructions: New schema entry: Add one training entry under cn=schema,cn=config. Use new numeric OIDs below 1.3.6.1.4.1.32473.220; leave the supplied base definitions unchanged. trainingBadge: Required text value, exactly one per trainingPerson; declare a compatible text equality rule. trainingPoints: Optional Integer values with integer equality. Several distinct values must work; invalid formats and equal duplicates must fail. trainingPerson: Inherit person, including cn and sn. Allow uid and trainingPoints, plus inherited optional description; reject unlisted fields. Verify and preserve data: Accept every valid Add/replacement and reject invalid data without changing stored entries. Check all three sample sets.
initial.starter:
version: 1

dn: cn=training,cn=schema,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcSchemaConfig
cn: training
olcAttributeTypes: (1.3.6.1.4.1.32473.220.1
  NAME 'trainingBadge'
  EQUALITY caseExactMatch
  SYNTAX 1.3.6.1.4.1.1466.115.121.1.15)
olcAttributeTypes: (1.3.6.1.4.1.32473.220.2
  NAME 'trainingPoints'
  EQUALITY caseExactMatch
  SYNTAX 1.3.6.1.4.1.1466.115.121.1.15)
olcObjectClasses: (1.3.6.1.4.1.32473.220.3
  NAME 'trainingPerson'
  SUP person STRUCTURAL
  MAY (uid $ trainingBadge $ trainingPoints))
initial.reference:
version: 1

dn: cn=training,cn=schema,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcSchemaConfig
cn: training
olcAttributeTypes: (1.3.6.1.4.1.32473.220.1
  NAME 'trainingBadge'
  EQUALITY caseExactMatch
  SYNTAX 1.3.6.1.4.1.1466.115.121.1.15
  SINGLE-VALUE)
olcAttributeTypes: (1.3.6.1.4.1.32473.220.2
  NAME 'trainingPoints'
  EQUALITY integerMatch
  SYNTAX 1.3.6.1.4.1.1466.115.121.1.27)
olcObjectClasses: (1.3.6.1.4.1.32473.220.3
  NAME 'trainingPerson'
  SUP person STRUCTURAL
  MUST trainingBadge
  MAY (uid $ trainingPoints))
